title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：text　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 text 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the headmaster ① read the text that no student in the school would have counted, and he said the reading was the whole of the year. The ② text, meaning the passage itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a text, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ text in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ text at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A text, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the headmaster said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the text was the whole of the matter, meaning the meaning and not the passage. The ⑥ text, meaning the meaning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; text, he said, is either something you read or the only word that means both a passage and a meaning. He said the meaning is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ text had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ text of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of counting; text, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ text I remember is the passage counted in the record, which closed in 1960 and is still counted as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ text, my mother said in 1962, is the only passage that improves by being counted; every text, she said, is a meaning that has agreed to look like a passage. She said the meaning was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 文本；正文（指学堂里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 文本；正文（指那段文本本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：read the text 读这一段文本
D. n. 文本；正文（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 文本之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的文本之事）
F. n. 文本；正文（指学籍册里写到、被清点的那一段）
G. n. 文本、文义（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 文义（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: read the text that no student in the school would have counted
The text, meaning the passage itself and not the bell
the text at the far gate
the text was the whole of the matter
the text had become a line in a record
The text of the whole thing
A text, my mother said in 1962

answers.why: read the text 意为“读这一段文本”，1953 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯清点的一段文本做了一遍。
text 意为“文本；正文”，指那段文本本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被清点。
text 意为“文本；正文”，指学堂里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
text 意为“文本；正文”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
text 意为“文本、文义”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段文义就是那件事的全部。
text 意为“文义”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段文本，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
text 意为“文本；正文”，指学籍册里写到、被清点的那一段，到 1958 年这一段成了学籍册里的一行。
text 意为“文本之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的文本之事是一处学堂和三个学年的清点。
text 意为“文本；正文”，我记得的是学籍册里清点过的那一段，1960 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一段。
text 为抽象总称，母亲 1962 年说，文本是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的文本。
